amendments.reason: FI_ALV_INSTRUCTIONS_NOTE gained the same-rate-composite and rent-follows-the-bill sentences (a salon's card payout is 25,5 %, never 'ALV-tarkistus'). An authored change to a coding note is a policy-version event, not a silent re-digest: fi_alv_coding version 1 -> 2; this case is re-captured from the amended implementation, the wave-4 capture stays the base for every other case.
Source component allocation, required owner facts and external balanced payroll evidence change the FI coding contract. Version 2 advances to 3.
The live coder named the missing withholding liability and substituted Payroll expense. Add the dedicated liability account and its settlement guidance; version 3 advances to 4.

Verified source discrepancies have a factual document question and reply continuation. The note preserves historical transport rates for pre-2025 supplies and advances; version 4 advances to 5. The live recheck must establish timing before using a historical rate; printed arithmetic alone is not exception evidence.
The Oy menu excludes sole-trader drawings and includes the existing shareholder-receivable role. Private-use evidence does not establish the shareholder relationship; version 5 advances to 6.

The FI menu gains 'Vähennyskelvoton ALV (osto)' (ALV_NONDEDUCTIBLE_INPUT) and FI_ALV_INSTRUCTIONS_NOTE defines it. A verdict chosen without that option may have coded a non-deductible purchase at a deductible rate, so it is re-judged: version 7 advances to 8, a stored version-7 suggestion conflicts at its next apply and re-codes under the clock; posted journals are unaffected. (The 6 -> 7 re-pin recorded no amendment; its prior digest was ee8dc1cbe84a5122a977b5708aaf33f3cf499ad987846cc3dcd35d701b0ed04e.)

Four workflow-contract sentences disagreed with the executable contract (docs/fik-1-fi-policy-clause-inventory.md §4.3): FI-POST-28 said tax-bearing document allocations were unsupported (they are supported and tested); FI-ALV-20 said 'ALV-tarkistus' flags the line for review (it becomes a source-document ask or a re-examination of the held source); FI-ALV-28 used 'ALV-tarkistus' to ask which tax a Verohallinto payment settles; FI-POST-20 said an unestablished historical-rate basis is always document_discrepancy (it is owner_fact without a verified source). No legal claim changed. Version 8 advances to 9; a stored version-8 suggestion conflicts at its next apply and re-codes under the clock; posted journals are unaffected.
